S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.

subtypes.With Depressed Mood: Symptoms mainly include low mood, tearfulness, or feelings of hopelessness.
subtypes.With Anxiety: Symptoms mainly include nervousness, worry, jitteriness, or separation anxiety.
subtypes.With Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood: A combination of depression and anxiety symptoms appears.
subtypes.With Disturbance of Conduct: Symptoms mainly involve violation of rules, truancy, vandalism, reckless driving, or fighting.
subtypes.With Mixed Disturbance of Emotions and C: Both emotional symptoms (depression, anxiety) and behavioral problems appear together.
subtypes.Unspecified: Maladaptive reactions not classified into the above types (e.g., physical complaints, social withdrawal).

patient_info.stressor_event: Foreclosure on a mortgage or loan
patient_info.stressor: Veronica’s adjustment difficulties began when she received formal foreclosure notices on a home-equity loan she had taken against her small Tennessee house to fund repairs, truck-club projects, and unexpected family expenses. Known for being disciplined and in control, she initially treated the paperwork like another equipment log, but the ongoing calls, deadlines, and fear of losing the home that anchored her routines steadily overtook her usual workshop confidence. Across 4 months, her stress-related behavioral and emotional reaction disrupted her mechanic duties, strained her mentorship of apprentices, and led her to withdraw from church volunteer work, fitness classes, and classic-truck outings she normally relied on. She came to psychiatric care after a safety supervisor pulled her from a high-risk repair bay following repeated lapses and the workplace occupational health clinician arranged an urgent referral.

S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.
S081.manifestation: Ever since those foreclosure notices started coming, I feel like I’m coming apart at the seams—crying in my truck before work, jumping every time the phone rings, snapping at the apprentices, and making stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never would’ve made before.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: Symptoms must develop within 3 months of the onset of the stressor
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: I was functioning normally until the foreclosure letters and calls started; within a few weeks of the first formal notice, my work and home life started unraveling.

additional_requirement_2.name: Additional Requirement 2
additional_requirement_2.description: Within 6 months of the termination of the stressor or its consequences
additional_requirement_2.manifestation: The foreclosure process still isn’t resolved, and I’m still dealing with the deadlines and calls, so this hasn’t continued past the end of it.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’ve been taken out of the high-risk repair bay at work, and I’ve stopped showing up for church volunteering, fitness classes, and truck-club outings I used to keep up with.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about four months, ever since the foreclosure notices started coming in.
